title: Check the links between projects
heading: A Rule Across Fields Goes in a Model Validator; a Rule Across Rows Goes Over the Whole File
cases: a list whose ids, parents and groups are consistent has no problems
a child whose parent is in no row is reported
a child in the same alternative group as its parent is reported
a parent listed after its child counts as known
an id that appears three times is one problem
a child and parent that both have no group are fine
a project that names itself as parent is reported as that, and only that
